data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate saw modest favourable prior year development in 2022, improving the loss ratio by 0.2pps (2021: 1.6pps). Favourable experience from prior year major losses was largely offset by adverse non-catastrophe related development across a handful of classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: reserves at 31 December 2022 are materially unchanged from those at 31 December 2021.

named_events.loss_description: cause for uncertainty; Syndicate has analysed its potential exposures across its (re)insurance portfolio as well as the wider financial and operational challenges brought about by the conflict. The Syndicate has limited exposure to the Russia-Ukraine conflict within the Casualty Treaty class and whole account quota share with Syndicate 2987, along with potential secondary impacts on classes such as Cyber.
COVID-19 related reserves at 31 December 2022 are materially unchanged from those at 31 December 2021.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a modest gross strengthening of GBP 0.1m in prior year reserves for 2022, as calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This was driven by a mix of favourable experience from prior year major losses and adverse non-catastrophe related development across various classes. This contrasts with the narrative which described a "modest favourable prior year development" on a net loss ratio basis. COVID-19 related reserves remained unchanged. The Russia-Ukraine conflict and general economic inflation were noted as ongoing geopolitical and economic factors impacting the business.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable experience from prior year major losses
adverse non-catastrophe related development across a handful of classes

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The calculated prior year development from the gross claims development triangle (+0.1m strengthening) conflicts with the narrative on page 3 which states 'modest favourable prior year development' and 'improving the loss ratio by 0.2pps' (a net figure implying a release). The gross triangle calculation was prioritized as per instructions.
